Name: HD Portraits Template for a Single Character
Author: thylakjoy
Description:
HD Portraits is still being updated for 1.6. I will update this template as needed.

✦

I noticed that a few people wanted to load in their own HD Portraits but were confused by the other template since they only wanted to change the portraits of one NPC. I have also noticed that learning how to use Content Patcher is quite daunting of a task for new modders. If it is for you, don't worry! I tried to make it as simple as possible.

All you need to do is make sure that the files are named and edited correctly. Json files can be opened and edited with the notepad app. You will need to open the "content.json" and replace "NPCName" with your character's name (ex. Cilan) and potentially the "base.json" to edit the size but don't be afraid. You can do this.

I tried to add comments in the content file for further explanation. You can delete the comments if you would like. Keeping them in won't break the template.

Most characters will have their internal names be the same as their display name, but for things like their Ginger Island portraits it would be "NPCName_Beach".

If you upload your own portrait mod using this template, be sure to change the author (Thylak) and mod name (HDPortraitsSingleTemplate) in the "manifest.json"! It's yours after all!

✦

You will need to download the HD Portraits framework mod to enable them to appear:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HD Portraits
[/url]
✦

For multiple characters, please use or reference the other template:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13361]HD Portraits Template[/url]
